name: Doppel
tagline: AI doubles talk to each other first to find people you would actually click with.
problem: Starting conversations with new people is exhausting and most go nowhere.
solution: Each user gets an AI representation; the agents converse to test compatibility before people are introduced, through an AI workflow platform.
demo_moment: Team-described: watch two AI doubles chat and decide whether to introduce you.

lessons: Letting agents do the awkward part is an easy-to-grasp agent story.
